ModMetaData.name: Skipdoor Fixes
ModMetaData.author: Luís Sousa
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial fixes for the Vanilla Psycasts Expanded skipdoor on RimWorld 1.7.
- No more UI flickering at 1x or the UI disappearing at 2x/3x while a skipdoor exists. - The portal no longer shows "screenshots" of your UI. - Pawns keep their job, duty and carried item when hopping through a skipdoor on the same map. - Pawns no longer arrive at the map corner or inside sealed, unexplored rooms. - Portals only redraw while on screen, at most once per frame.
Patch-only, safe to add or remove mid-save.
